source_scope: ARM64 bootstrap adaptation, not the unchanged pinned program. The existing adaptation uses message-based pointer input and supports Escape; the current change restores the upstream catch/cleanup behavior for Ctrl-Alt-C.
negative_control: Before the catch was restored, Ctrl-Alt-C left the board on screen and the terminal input was not visible; the graphical recovery check failed.
result: After restoring cleanup, QEMU VirtIO and emulated xHCI USB runs each rendered the board, made two mouse turns, exited with Ctrl-Alt-C and evaluated 40+2 as 42 in the visible graphical terminal. The separate VirtIO Escape workflow also passed. The Ctrl-Alt-C test recognizes the expected upstream-style Except: Break text rather than treating it as a new failure.
limits: Two moves and exit only; full game outcomes, live UTM and Pi hardware remain unverified.
